title: Product Bundle Photos for Clearer Listings | AIVideosUGC
description: Show every item in your kit in one square bundle photo. Use it on Amazon, Shopify, gift pages, social ads, and posts without booking another photo shoot.
h1: Product Bundle Photos That Show Every Shipped Piece
lead: Shoppers can count the set from one square. A skillet, a lid, and a spatula in one photo is what the parcel contains. A short video of the same set can carry speech afterward.
steps_h2: How to Make a Bundle Photo in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: You get one square file shoppers can count, from one photo of the candle set. Add a script if you also want a kit video.

steps.d: The candle, the matches, and the card can each stay visible in the setup you pick.
One clear picture of the complete candle set is enough, and every piece in the parcel shows up in the square.
Save a square of the candle set with every piece visible. A kit video can use a script and spoken AI voice.

faq.q: What does a product bundle photo template include?
faq.a: It is a square for the set you ship. Put the mugs, the cocoa, and the ribbon in one photo and download that square. A short video can be added when the listing also needs speech.

faq.q: How does the bundle photo come together?
faq.a: One photo of the full set is the input. Keep the hammer on the left and the case on the right so neither one hides, then download the square. Several kits can start from your own software through the API.

faq.q: Why this instead of another photo shoot?
faq.a: The picnic-basket photo you took on the table is the one to use. A second video of the set does not mean renting lights again.

faq.q: Who should use a kit layout?
faq.a: Shops, gift brands, and agencies that need a contents view for a listing, a bundle page, or an ad. Owners with one set to show fit here too.

faq.q: Can I do this on a first try?
faq.a: Yes, when every piece is already in the photo. Follow the three steps. If you also make a video, set captions, a song, and an AI voice in the editor on this site.

faq.q: Which shops is this layout for?
faq.a: Any set you ship as one unit: skincare kits, gifts, care bundles, and similar groups. Clothing, food singles, and electronics live in the wider library. Open another template when you are not showing a set.

A JPG, PNG, or WebP of the complete kit, or a short clip you have the rights to. Include the box and the paper insert when they ship with the order. The square keeps the pieces that were in that photo.

faq.q: Where can I publish the kit file?
faq.a: The photo is square, for a product gallery. A video of the same kit can be 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4. Use the tall file for a TikTok placement and the square for a Facebook feed. YouTube can take the wide file. Instagram or LinkedIn can take the download, or you post it yourself.

faq.q: What does a bundle photo cost?
faq.a: Each product photo spends 24 credits. A video is 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. You see the number first. If it fails, those credits come back. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600.

faq.q: Can I use the image in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. The file is clean of any overlaid mark, and a client delivery can use the same kit square.

faq.q: Why a kit template instead of an empty frame?
faq.a: The way the pieces are arranged is already in the layout. Your time goes to the notebook, the pen, and the clips matching the contents list.

faq.q: When do I add the price?
faq.a: After download, in your own editor. The generated file does not invent the current price. If the offer changes, change that text instead of trusting an old file.
